description:

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist - GTM Focus (m/f/d)
description:
Build the Commercial Team Driving the Energy Transition
Most recruiting jobs are about filling vacancies.
 This one is about building the team that drives the growth of one of Europe’s fastest-growing start-ups - at the intersection of AI & climate tech.
At Reonic, we're building the AI-native operating system for renewable installers. Every SDR, Account Executive, Sales Manager, and Marketing hire you make directly influences how fast we grow—and how much impact we can create.
If you love finding exceptional commercial talent, moving fast, and partnering with ambitious hiring managers, you'll fit right in.
 Please note this is a full-time, on-site position based in Berlin.
 What makes this role different
 You'll own hiring across our Go-to-Market organization, with a strong focus on SDRs, Account Executives, Sales leadership , and other revenue-generating roles
 You'll partner directly with founders and sales leaders on some of the company's highest-impact hires
 You'll build talent pipelines before we need them—not after positions open
 You'll have the freedom to experiment with sourcing strategies and continuously improve our recruiting engine
 Your hires will directly influence our growth across Europe
 No waiting for applications. No unnecessary processes.
Just finding exceptional commercial talent and convincing them to join a company that's changing an industry.

 Own full-cycle recruiting for Sales, Business Development, and other GTM roles—from sourcing through onboarding
 Proactively source exceptional SDRs, Account Executives, Sales Managers, and other commercial talent
 Occasionally recruit for Marketing and other business roles as the company grows
 Partner with hiring managers to define hiring strategies, interview processes, and hiring decisions

title: Operations Management Intern (Greentech) – Italy (m/f/d)
description:
Are you eager to gain hands-on experience in a fast-growing renewable energy startup?
 Do you thrive in dynamic environments where you can drive impact and implement innovative solutions? If you’re passionate about sales, technology, and sustainability, this internship is for you!
 Please note that for this role, C2 Italian proficiency is required. This is a full-time, on-site position based in Berlin.

 Translate customer feedback into actionable product insights and help shape new features.
 Collaborate with the Co-Founders and Head of Account Management on ad hoc initiatives (e.g. trade shows, internal product testing, competitor benchmarking).
 Assist with drafting product specifications and feature requests based on real customer use cases.
 Set up and configure customer accounts tailored to their business needs.
 Be the go-to technical contact for German customers via support chat, WhatsApp, or email.
 Join customer calls alongside Account Managers to provide product expertise and ensure smooth onboarding.
 Provide administrative support , maintaining customer records and tracking key engagement metrics.
 What Makes You a Great Fit
 Currently in the final year of a top engineering or business school, or taking a gap year from one.
 Structured, proactive, and eager to learn in a fast-paced environment.
 Strong interest in customer success, sales, and customer engagement.
 Ideally start in September/October.
 Available for at least 5 month internship in our Berlin office.
 Bonus: Previous experience in SaaS, startups, or customer-facing roles.

 Be part of a fast-growing VC-backed startup with a mission-driven approach.
 Gain hands-on experience in different areas of sales.
 Freedom to experiment and bring your ideas to life in a small, creative team.
 Real ownership and responsibility from day one.
